title: Rotating a primitive subarray by the smallest integer distance
summary: Both Guava distributions rotated by Integer.MIN_VALUE in the same direction as the independently rotated boxed list. Changing the cells outside the subrange preserved its five values.

change.description: Guava changes distance normalization in its primitive array rotation methods so the most negative int has its mathematical meaning.

notes: The distance is congruent to 2 modulo 5. Only the subrange participates in its period and its permutation.
